purpose: Teach: 天神/芦屋/藤岡/萩原/フィジカル/エキサイトブログ/ハンナ/ケインズ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族旅行で福岡天神行ったろ
lines.en: Riku — didn't your family go to Fukuoka Tenjin on that trip?
lines.style: Light, probing. Calling him out with a smile in her voice. Fast pace, no hesitation — she already knows the answer and wants to see him react.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、芦屋のお祖父ちゃんち泊まったろ、桜
lines.en: Your grandpa's place in Ashiya — you stayed there, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet counter-strike. Lean back, match her tempo. The faintest hint of 'two can play this game' underneath. Casual but precise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、藤岡弘、の特撮ドラマ観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were totally into that tokusatsu show with Fujikawa Hiroshi, weren't you?
lines.style: Dry edge underneath the innocent question. Slight uptick on the reveal — she's enjoying this. Measured pace, the tone of someone who's done their homework.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で萩原朔太郎の詩読んでたろ、桜
lines.en: You read Hagiwara Sakutaro's poetry in Japanese class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Same pitch as before — measured, unruffled. Slight stress on 「お前」, ownership. He's matching her beat for beat, neither one backing down.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカー部でフィジカル強化してたな
lines.en: Riku — you've been doing serious strength training with the soccer team, right?
lines.style: Pressing forward. Eyes bright. Raising stakes slightly — this one's a bigger thing, and she knows it. Pace quickens just a touch, confident.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エキサイトブログでファンサイト作ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were running a fan site on Excite Blog, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, measured comeback. A small smile in the tone — not mean, but he's enjoying the symmetry of catching her. Hold the beat steady, let it land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、海外ピアニストのハンナを応援してたな
lines.en: Riku — you've been supporting that pianist, Hanna, haven't you?
lines.style: Shift down. Lower energy, more genuine curiosity now. Less teasing, more real. She's moved past the game to something that actually matters. Softer attack.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、経済の授業でケインズ経済学習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned Keynesian economics in your econ class, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Pull back to matching her new tone. Still measured, but warmer. The game has shifted — he's no longer deflecting, just... present. Close, attentive.
